September 11, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-11-1971-54684

Mukti Bahini guerrillas start to plant mines on the roads and highways, a Pak army spokesperson admits in Dhaka. He also admits the guerrilla attacks on Pak troops, Razakars and pro-government militias.

William Rogers, the US foreign secretary urges the Congress to continue supporting “Pakistan’s development”. “We urged Pakistan government to create such environment that the refugees can return home,” he says.
